items.title: PowerShell Payload Unpacked
items.description:
PowerShell fires and starts pulling together several different pieces, including a fake Cloudflare page, browser processes with their sandbox disabled, and activity involving timeout.exe.

I follow the different processes the payload kicks off and try to figure out what is happening along the way.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/oJHOlNTH7lY?si=8LruOkxZlfvFLII-

items.title: Safeguarding YOLO Developer Workflows With Docker by Oleg Šelajev | IntelliJ IDEA Conf 2026
items.description:
How can you give coding agents more autonomy while protecting your machine and credentials? At IntelliJ IDEA Conf 2026, Oleg Šelajev demonstrates Docker Sandboxes, exploring microVM isolation, network controls, and secret injection, plus reusable configurations and integration with IntelliJ IDEA.

Timestamps
00:00 – Intro
01:22 – Running coding agents in YOLO mode: what could go wrong?
07:16 – Private data, external communication, and prompt injection
12:40 – Why permissions and prompt-based guardrails aren’t enough
14:45 – Experiment: exposing credentials through an agent skill
19:01 – Why agents need a hard isolation boundary
21:52 – Introducing Docker Sandboxes and SBX
23:55 – Demo: running Claude in an isolated microVM
26:09 – Controlling network access and inspecting blocked requests
28:45 – Managing secrets with proxy-based credential injection
30:55 – What sandbox isolation doesn’t prevent
32:08 – Supported agents and sandbox lifecycle
34:13 – Adding tools and configuring your environment
36:00 – Sandbox kits: tooling, network rules, and secrets
38:40 – Demo: anatomy of a sandbox kit
42:31 – Combining kits with SBX env
44:28 – Demo: connecting an agent to Google Workspace
47:52 – Creating and publishing your own kits
50:06 – Private kits and shared team configurations
51:47 – Demo: integrating a sandboxed agent with IntelliJ IDEA via ACP
53:29 – Running sandboxed agents in CI
54:33 – Enterprise governance and centralized policies
55:30 – Local development vs. fully isolated software factories

Watch all IntelliJ IDEA Conf 2026 sessions:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPZy-hmwOdEWItbnW5iDHlXLwnq5RTVYi
